description: This file declares functions related to caching tensors in the ATen library of PyTorch, specifically for managing cached tensors, checking if a tensor is cached, adding/removing cached tensors, enabling caching, and adjusting tensor use counts within the at::caching namespace.

methods.name: is_cached_tensor
methods.description: Checks if a given tensor is a cached tensor under certain system conditions.

methods.name: add_cached_tensor
methods.description: Adds a tensor to the cache.

methods.name: remove_cached_tensor
methods.description: Removes a tensor from the cache.

methods.name: set_cached_tensors_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the caching of tensors.

methods.name: adjusted_use_count
methods.description: Returns an adjusted reference use count for a tensor, considering gradient buffer stealing.
